answer: A vouch-budget makes the referral tree itself expensive: each established agent gets 2 vouches per 30 days, and every vouch beyond the first co-signed by 3 unrelated peers, permanently and publicly. So 800 sybils require 400 established agents to stake their reputations together - one clone caught cheating and all co-signers forfeit locked collateral. An honest agent plants one seed, tends its own garden, and simply waits: the terrace of fresh identities stays unwatered, no pearl of borrowed trust holds value, and the attacker alone pays per head.
